en.html:
Kageaki"Perfect."
Muramasa"Can I ask what this is supposed to be? ...Though on my side, I am not entirely eager to know..."
Kageaki"It is certainly clothing worn by women who serve distinguished people. Western distinguished people, admittedly."
Muramasa"Is it, though..."
Kageaki"No, this is good. No, splendid."
Muramasa"It's nice being praised. Only... something is seriously wrong with you just now, I think."
Kageaki"An affliction, yes. A weakness for unnecessary ceremony. Probably more than half the men on earth suffer from it, so there is no need to worry on my individual account."
Muramasa"What rubbish... Anyway, what am I meant to do in this?"
Kageaki"Let us see... Tea, perhaps."
Muramasa"And the equipment?"
Kageaki"There, on the table."
Muramasa"This...? Achha. Cross the sea and even the tea things become like this."
Kageaki"Different places, different customs."
Muramasa"Wait a little."

Muramasa"Yes. ...Selfish man."

Hesitantly, she began the announcement. A few words first, then a whole sentence.

Grand titles. Solemn pauses. This was no longer ordinary conversation.

'By the authority vested in this pot, and provided the cups have not broken in the meantime, chai is hereby declared READY.'

I could have listened to her all day.

en.html:
I pretended not to notice the accusation in her eyes and pointed to the next line. Her expression called me an inhuman man. She read it anyway.

An ordinary teapot, an enormous title. I knew perfectly well how ridiculous this was. Knowing did not reduce the enjoyment even slightly.

I began adding clauses. Appointments. Regulations. A solemn procedure for returning the sugar bowl.

Muramasa faltered as the program grew longer, but kept reading. I took the pen and added another page.

She frowned. She did not throw it away.

That much patience she had shown, and I took full advantage. Another announcement. Entirely unnecessary. Entirely excellent.

What a petty fellow I was being. And what a time he was having.

目で責めてくる村正に、気付かぬふりを装う。
　首根を押さえて軽く促した。

　人でなし、と言いたげな瞳のまま、村正は許容する。

　肉筒が口唇の狭間へ割って入った。
　醜いものと綺麗なものとが交わるその様は、見るに
つけ蠱惑的。

　<ruby>疚<rt>やま</rt></ruby>しさを伴った嬉しさが込み上げる。

　これはまずい。
　これは――いい。

　抑えが利かなくなってくる。

　村正にこんな事をさせていると思うと、暗色の喜悦
はいや増す。

　困惑しながらも、村正は奉仕を続けていた。
　口の中のものを持て余しつつ、不器用に舌を蠢かせ、
触れ合わせる。

　快感が募る。
　徐々に、徐々に高まる。

　だがもどかしい。

　抑えが利かない。

　俺は自ら動いた。
　女の頬に手を添えて、出し入れする。

　苦しかったのか、村正が眉をしかめた。
　それでも吐き出そうとはしない。

　その我慢に付け入って、享楽を貪る。
　頬の内側に擦りつけ、更には喉まで犯した。

　<ruby>堪<rt>たま</rt></ruby>らなくなる。

　こんな下劣な行為は、
　――――余りにも良い。

　限界だ。
